archetypes.name: prompt-drift
archetypes.rationale: Review whether the new reminders reach the intended author surfaces without changing runtime behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that the design readability note applies only to plans touching Bash fences in skills/implement/SKILL.md. Verify the in-repo rule gives implementers enough detail to inspect scripts/test-implement-fence-shape.sh and update EXPECTED_OLD or EXPECTED_NEW when needed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: pyright-tests
archetypes.rationale: Review the Python test monkeypatch guidance for precise pyright strict-mode scope.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check that the new python/test_*.py rule prefers typed helpers and limits type ignores to inline monkeypatch lambdas that lack parameter context. Verify it points to the existing test_pr_body.py pattern without encouraging broad or unnecessary suppressions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
